purpose: Pass/fail rules for a blind deterministic meter of discrete audio onsets, visual change onsets and audio-minus-video offset. Not semantic, perceptual or production approval.
blindness: The meter receives only the media path. It never reads manifests, recipes, expected counts or offsets.
Qualification copies each stimulus alone into an empty directory and runs the meter in a separate isolated interpreter.
Expected values come from the preserved recipe nominal constants (flash starts 1/3/5 s; tone shift +0.5, 0, -0.5 s; c02 no flashes; c03 exact zero PCM), never from meter output.
stimulus_identity: Stimuli are rebuilt with the preserved recipe and must be byte-identical (SHA-256) to the five frozen controls; otherwise qualification stops before measuring.

rules.digital_silence: Control with all-zero PCM must report exact_digital_silence=true and zero audio onsets.
rules.constant_image: Control with a constant image must report zero visual onsets.
rules.offset_definition: Median of paired (audio onset - visual onset); positive means sound lags picture.
rules.sync_verdict: ITU-R BT.1359 detectability window: in sync iff -0.045 <= offset <= +0.125 s. c01 (+0.5) and c05 (-0.5) must be OUT_OF_SYNC; c04 (0) must be IN_SYNC; c02/c03 must be NOT_MEASURABLE (no pairs).
rules.generalization: Offline synthetic tests with counts, times, levels, noise floor, frame rates, sample rates and channel layouts that differ from the five controls must pass with the same tolerances; meter parameters may not be tuned per control.

failure_policy: Any rule failure is reported as FAIL; criteria are not edited after results to pass.
out_of_scope: Identifying speech, music, sound effects or visual content.
Continuous music, dense speech or gradual visual motion as countable events.
Perceptual quality, originality, rights, production or publication approval.
